responsibility: Implements human-readable MIR rendering and dump-file generation, including pass-filtered MIR dumping, pretty-printing of bodies, allocations, and constants, and integration with Graphviz output for diagnostics and compiler debugging.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `ty/print/pretty.rs`, which pretty-prints type-system entities generally, this file is dedicated to MIR-specific textual rendering and dump-file generation: bodies, CFG-oriented output, allocations, and MIR constants for debugging and diagnostics.
